question: In Table 4, what capacity retention did the uncoated and the Al2O3 (2%)-coated Li1.2Mn0.54Ni0.13Co0.13O2 show?
expect: 92.43% before (251→232) and 94.83% after coating (271→257), 0.05C, 30 cycles (p13.T4 r5)
